jobs.job_description:
Apex Group Ltd is a global financial services provider headquartered in Bermuda (founded in 2003), offering fund administration, corporate services, ESG solutions, and digital banking. It operates in over 52 countries with more than 13,000 employees.




Job Location - Pune / Bangalore

Cab Facility- Yes

Role- AI Solution Engineer

Exp- 4 to 8 yr

Job Summary

Owns the model lifecycle strategy underpinning the agent ecosystem: model selection, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment automation, and cost/performance optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Own model selection and fine-tuning strategy across the agent portfolio, balancing quality, cost, and latency.
Design and maintain robust MLOps pipelines for training, evaluation, versioning, and rollback of models.
Establish production monitoring for model drift, degradation, and safety metrics.
Partner with Agentic Engineers and Prompt Engineers to diagnose whether issues are model-level or prompt/orchestration-level.
Lead capacity planning and cost-optimization initiatives for model inference at scale.
Mentor Associate-level engineers and set MLOps best practices.

Required Qualifications

4-7 years of experience in ML engineering/MLOps,.
Strong expertise in model training frameworks, distributed training/inference, and evaluation methodology.
Experience with production ML infrastructure (Kubernetes, model-serving frameworks, feature/vector stores).
Track record of optimizing model cost/latency/quality trade-offs at scale.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and reinforcement-learning-based alignment techniques.
Including production fine-tuning and deployment of LLMs
Experience in a regulated industry with model-risk-management requirements.

Core Competencies

Technical leadership
Operational excellence
Cost/performance judgment
Mentorship

Please mail your details to below email id- shivangi.singh@apexgroup.com

EXP-

CCTC-

ECTC-

NP-

Preferred Location- Pune or Bangalore




Comfortable with 4 days office- Yes/No ( Cab Facility Available)




Available for Virtual ( Online) Weekend Drive 31st Oct- Yes/No




Regards,

Shivangi Singh

This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early-career developer with hands-on exposure to building web applications through internships, hackathons, or academic/personal projects. Youll work across the stack building responsive user interfaces with React.js and robust backend services with Python (Flask/Django) while collaborating closely with senior engineers to ship real features.

Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using Python (Flask or Django)
Integrate frontend applications with backend services and third-party APIs
Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases (MySQL / MongoDB) for data modeling and queries
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews, testing (including manual and API testing via tools like Postman), and debugging
Collaborate with designers, product managers, and other engineers to understand requirements and deliver features within timelines
Assist in identifying and fixing bugs, and improving application performance and usability
Required Skills
Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js
Working knowledge of Python with experience in Flask or Django
Familiarity with REST API design and integration
Basic experience with MySQL and/or MongoDB
Understanding of version control tools (Git/GitHub)
Exposure to API testing tools such as Postman
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving ability
Good communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment
Good to Have
Exposure to LLM models and AI integration.
Experience with web scraping or data extraction modules
Basic understanding of ML-assisted or rule-based analysis (e.g., security/fraud detection use cases)
Prior internship experience in a full-stack role
Participation in hackathons or coding competitions
A portfolio of personal or academic full-stack projects (GitHub links welcome)
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Strong academic record preferred
0-1 years of relevant experience through internships, projects, or hackathons
